responsibility: This file defines the NDS32 RTL optimization pass that decides whether a function should repurpose the frame-pointer register as a general small-data base register (“fp as gp”) for code-size reduction on 16-bit non-Linux targets. It analyzes per-function control-flow and exit structure, prologue requirements, varargs/frame-pointer constraints, and counts symbol-based load/store accesses to estimate size benefit; then it updates IRA register availability and cfun machine state so later prologue/epilogue and addressing code can generate the alternate base-register scheme.
